Under Bob Mumgaard’s leadership, the company has accelerated advances in high temperature superconducting magnets and reactor design. It also plans to deploy the first commercial fusion power plants.

Reuters Energy & Environment Correspondent Tim Gardner sits down with Mumgaard at Reuters New York City newsroom just a month after Mumgaard was appointed by US President Donald Trump as one of the first members of the President’s Council of Advisors on Science and Technology.
